failure_mode: Loss of pressure generation / no fluid delivery
failure_causes: ["Drive coupling mechanical failure", "Internal pump seizure or mechanical wear"]
effect_local: Zero hydraulic flow and pressure delivered to the supply line
effect_next_level: Insufficient hydraulic power supplied to directional valve
effect_end_effect: Failure to achieve commanded motion and inability to move the mechanical load
recommended_actions: ["Evaluate condition monitoring requirements and define periodic inspection criteria"]

failure_causes: ["Internal pump bypass leakage", "Fluid aeration or cavitation at suction port"]
effect_local: Fluid supply pressure delivered below nominal design range
effect_next_level: Reduced pressure differential across the actuator chambers
effect_end_effect: Degraded, slow, or incomplete load motion under variable load conditions
recommended_actions: ["Define minimum operating pressure limits and evaluate suction line design"]

failure_causes: ["Reservoir shell structural breach", "Fitting or seal rupture at reservoir connection"]
effect_local: Depletion of hydraulic fluid volume in reservoir
effect_next_level: Pump fluid starvation and aeration of pressure lines
effect_end_effect: Loss of actuation capability and potential pump damage from dry running
recommended_actions: ["Investigate fluid level detection provisions and containment inspection protocols"]

failure_mode: Spool fails to shift on command
failure_causes: ["Spool contamination or particulate binding", "Actuator/solenoid drive signal or electrical interface failure"]
effect_local: Valve spool does not transition to commanded position
effect_next_level: Fluid flow is not directed to the appropriate actuator port
effect_end_effect: Actuator fails to move or fails to reverse direction on command
recommended_actions: ["Define fluid filtration standards and spool shift validation procedures"]

failure_mode: Inability to isolate actuator ports at commanded stop
failure_causes: ["Valve spool land erosion or internal seal wear", "Spool fails to center fully upon stop command"]
effect_local: Hydraulic fluid bypasses valve spool lands
effect_next_level: Actuator chambers cannot maintain locked fluid volume at stop
effect_end_effect: Uncommanded actuator motion or drift during commanded stop
recommended_actions: ["Determine allowable internal leakage limits and assess load-holding requirements"]

failure_causes: ["Piston dynamic seal wear or degradation", "Piston cylinder bore scoring"]
effect_local: Fluid bypasses directly between extend and retract chambers
effect_next_level: Loss of differential hydraulic pressure across the actuator piston
effect_end_effect: Inability to move load at rated speed or maintain position under load
recommended_actions: ["Specify cylinder seal inspection criteria and assess seal material compatibility"]

failure_causes: ["Mechanical misalignment or excessive side loading", "Foreign object or debris wedged in cylinder assembly"]
effect_local: Piston rod mechanically constrained from translation
effect_next_level: Circuit pressure rises to relief valve limit
effect_end_effect: Actuator seized; complete inability to achieve commanded motion
recommended_actions: ["Analyze side-load tolerances and evaluate mechanical alignment under variable load"]

failure_mode: Signal frozen or unresponsive to actual pressure changes
failure_causes: ["Sensing port clogging or contamination", "Internal sensor transducer element lockup"]
effect_local: Sensor output signal remains constant or nominal despite actual pressure variance
effect_end_effect: Failure to alert operator or controller to true line pressure anomalies
recommended_actions: ["Investigate diagnostic plausibility checks or signal health monitoring"]

failure_mode: Erroneous zero or low pressure reading
failure_causes: ["Signal wiring open circuit or loose terminal", "Internal sensing element circuit failure"]
effect_local: Zero or out-of-range low voltage/current signal produced
effect_next_level: Controller registers an erroneous loss of hydraulic pressure
effect_end_effect: False abnormal pressure alert or unnecessary system interruption
recommended_actions: ["Establish circuit continuity diagnostics and signal threshold validation logic"]
